cand.title: VFW Auxiliary Mid-Year Conference 2027
cand.excerpt: Dated local event with venue unannounced; commercial accessibility could be real but evidence quality needs verification.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Val Cooper, Veterans Travel Service representative, is the strongest operational entry point: the official 2025 retrospective places her welcoming conference arrivals, while the 2027 flyer routes bookings to val@vtstvl.com. Donna K. Mills is National President for 2026–2027 and the named leader of the 2027 conference; she is an organizational sponsor/referral contact, not a verified purchasing signatory. Neither person is proven to hold sole hotel-contract authority.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming edition: February 2–7, 2027, Majestic Mirage All-Inclusive Resort, Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. Both the national calendar and official flyer establish activity dates, not publication dates. The flyer filename contains 2026, but its body explicitly identifies the 2027 conference. No 2028 Mid-Year edition/date/destination was identified in the reviewed official calendar; later recurrence is not a confirmed local booking.
findings.hotelProductFit: Conditional fit for a future resort edition, not an available 2027 block: five-night all-inclusive stays and receptions align with Wyndham Alltra’s guestroom-led resort product. Its official page publishes 620 rooms, three event facilities, 380 m², capacity for 300 conference guests or 200 banquet guests, and outdoor event settings. Material constraint: the 2025 official retrospective reports more than 350 attendees and around 350 at the council meeting, exceeding Alltra’s published 300-person conference capacity if a comparable plenary were required. This is a historical comparison, not a 2027 attendance forecast. Do not pursue the entire conference without a verified headcount and compliant meeting plan.
findings.venueCommitments: Majestic Mirage is the announced 2027 host. The official sign-up form explicitly refers to the VFW Auxiliary adults-only room block and publishes five-night accommodation packages. This is an actual event-specific host/block commitment, not a preferred-hotel list. Contract terms and block quantity are not published in the reviewed documents.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified sequence: 2023 Mexico cruise from Los Angeles; 2024 Mariner of the Seas cruise; 2025 Hideaway at Royalton Riviera Cancun, Mexico; 2026 Celebrity Reflection cruise from Fort Lauderdale; 2027 Majestic Mirage, Punta Cana. This establishes recurring Mid-Year editions and movement between cruises and resorts, not annual Punta Cana demand or a guaranteed Dominican Republic return.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Reservations are routed through Veterans Travel Service, Inc. (VTS), 800-325-9377, val@vtstvl.com. The 2027 form offers five-night resort packages, room categories and occupancy rates, first-come allocation, and an adults-only Auxiliary block. It states a November 1 sign-up deadline and release of unsold spaces afterward; the deadline year is not printed. Inference: it most likely means November 1, 2026, before the February 2027 departure, hence likely already elapsed as of November 14, 2026. Late participant availability must be checked with VTS. No open host-hotel procurement or RFP was found. Registration availability is not hotel-sourcing availability.
findings.organizationStructure: The event owner/organizer is VFW Auxiliary, a national membership-based veterans’ service organization, not a corporate incentive client or local DMC. National officers are elected annually and run national meetings. VTS is the separately named travel/reservations service; Majestic Mirage is the host resort. No separate PCO or Dominican DMC is identified in the reviewed event materials; legal contracting entity and signatory remain unverified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The 2027 guestroom package and adults-only Auxiliary block are already placed at Majestic Mirage. Its inventory quantity, sellout status and overflow requirements are not published in the reviewed primary materials. No evidence supports overflow to Wyndham Alltra or incumbent service/capacity deficiencies. The 10times seed’s generic industry-conference copy and 2K+ expected-people claim are not accepted as organizer-confirmed demand; official material identifies a veterans’ Auxiliary gathering. Alltra’s plenary limit is a separate, evidenced obstacle to full-event capture.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Val Cooper via the published VTS event channel first. Acknowledge Majestic Mirage as the 2027 host; ask whether any genuine unmet accommodation need exists, who selects/contracts future resorts, and when the next resort-versus-cruise decision occurs. Request prior/forecast peak rooms, single/double mix, largest mandatory plenary, banquet size and adults-only requirements. Ask National Headquarters to route the relationship to the actual meetings/procurement lead, with Donna Mills as the named 2027 organizational sponsor. Present Alltra only as a conditional future resort option; do not send a replacement-2027 or assumed-overflow proposal. Disclose the 300-conference/200-banquet limits before requesting an RFP.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Low for primary 2027 hotel capture: host and accommodation block are already announced elsewhere. Participant late booking may or may not remain possible through VTS, but does not create an open hotel RFP. Overflow, extensions at another resort and split accommodation are unverified and must not be counted as demand for Alltra.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Relationship-development potential only. Multiple documented editions, including resort stays in 2025 and 2027, support discussing future resort cycles. Cruise editions show resort selection is not guaranteed. No 2028 Punta Cana date, host or sourcing window is established. A future full-event bid is conditional on a plenary requirement within Alltra’s published capacity; a smaller independently sourced leadership group is only an exploratory possibility, not an identified requirement.
